ingredients.publisher: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), National Library of Medicine (NLM), NIH — PubChem

known_effects.text_zh: 烟酸和烟酰胺用于预防烟酸缺乏并治疗癞皮病；部分临床医生更倾向于用烟酰胺治疗癞皮病，因为它没有血管扩张作用。
known_effects.supporting_quote: Niacin and niacinamide are used to prevent niacin deficiency and to treat pellagra. Some clinicians prefer niacinamide for the treatment of pellagra because it lacks vasodilating effects.
known_effects.locator: Drug and Medication Information > Therapeutic Uses (HSDB record; flagged /Included in US product label/)

known_effects.text_zh: 烟酰胺被登记为化妆品原料，并被归类为具有“柔滑/平滑（Smoothing）”作用的个人护理产品成分（润肤剂－酰胺类）。
known_effects.locator: Chemical and Physical Properties > Chemical Classes > Cosmetics (additional verbatim entries in the same block: 'Smoothing'; 'Personal care product -> emollient -> amide')

irritancy.text_zh: ECHA C&L 汇总的 GHS 分类显示：28.6% 的报告分类为 H315“造成皮肤刺激”，99.6% 的报告分类为 H319“造成严重眼刺激”。该分类来自工业化学品的 ECHA C&L 通报汇总，并非化妆品终产品的刺激性结论。
irritancy.supporting_quote: H315 (28.6%): Causes skin irritation [Warning Skin corrosion/irritation] | H319 (99.6%): Causes serious eye irritation [Warning Serious eye damage/eye irritation] | H335 (28.4%): May cause respiratory irritation [Warning Specific target organ toxicity, single exposure; Respiratory tract irritation]
irritancy.locator: Safety and Hazards > Hazards Identification > GHS Classification > GHS Hazard Statements (ECHA C&L Inventory aggregation, ref. 48)

life_extension.text_zh: 该物质被直接添加到人类食品中，并被确认为一般认为安全（GRAS）；同时作为营养强化剂用于膳食补充。
life_extension.supporting_quote: Substance added directly to human food affirmed as generally recognized as safe (GRAS).
life_extension.locator: Safety and Hazards > Regulatory Information > FDA Requirements (also: Food Additives and Ingredients > FDA Substances Added to Food, Used for (Technical Effect): 'FLAVOR ENHANCER, FLAVORING AGENT OR ADJUVANT, NUTRIENT SUPPLEMENT')

ingredients.notes: PubChem compound page https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/936 renders behind a reCAPTCHA challenge when fetched directly (HTTP 200 but body is a 'Checking your browser' interstitial), so the record content was retrieved and verified through NCBI's own machine-readable endpoint for the same record: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug_view/data/compound/936/JSON (HTTP 200, fetched 2026-10-15). All quotes above are verbatim from that PUG-View record for CID 936 (RecordTitle 'Nicotinamide'). The irritation data is an industrial SDS/GHS aggregation, not a cosmetic-use assessment; INCI name 'Niacinamide' itself was not confirmed on this page (PubChem uses 'Nicotinamide').

ingredients.publisher: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), National Library of Medicine (NLM), NIH — PubChem

known_effects.text_zh: 水杨酸及其盐在化妆品中的原料功能为：抗痤疮剂、抗头皮屑剂、鸡眼/胼胝/疣去除剂、变性剂、护发剂以及皮肤调理剂（其他类）。
known_effects.supporting_quote: Cosmetic ingredient functions of Salicylic Acid and its salts. Ingredient: Salicylic Acid; Function: Antiacne agent, Antidanduff agent, Corn/callus/wart remover, Denaturant, Hair-conditioning agent, and Skin-conditioning agent (miscellaneous). /From table/
known_effects.locator: Drug and Medication Information > Therapeutic Uses (Cosmetic Ingredient Review functions table)

known_effects.text_zh: 水杨酸一直用于非处方外用抗痤疮制剂（浓度为 2% 至 5%）、用于毒藤/毒橡树/毒漆树的外用镇痛剂与皮肤保护剂，以及外用抗真菌药品中。
known_effects.supporting_quote: Salicylic acid has been present in OTC topical acne preparations (at concentrations of 2% to 5%), external analgesics and skin protectants used for poison ivy, oak and sumac, and topical antifungal drug products.
known_effects.locator: Drug and Medication Information > Therapeutic Uses

irritancy.text_zh: 一项含 1.5% 水杨酸的面部护肤霜被按标准化评分归类为“轻微刺激”；此外水杨酸粉尘会刺激鼻腔。
irritancy.supporting_quote: A facial cosmetic cream containing 1.5% salicylic acid, with a total score of 415.0 and a normalized score of 147.5, was classified (using the normalized score) as slightly irritating.
irritancy.locator: Safety and Hazards > Hazards Identification > Skin, Eye, and Respiratory Irritations (a further verbatim entry in the same section reads: '/Salicylic acid/ ... dust irritates the nostrils.')

life_extension.text_zh: 该物质被登记为化妆品原料，其功能包括防腐剂（Preservative）与角质剥脱剂（Keratolytic）。
life_extension.locator: Chemical and Physical Properties > Chemical Classes > Cosmetics

ingredients.notes: PubChem compound page https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/338 renders behind a reCAPTCHA challenge when fetched directly, so the record content was retrieved and verified through NCBI's own machine-readable endpoint for the same record: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug_view/data/compound/338/JSON (HTTP 200, fetched 2026-10-15). All quotes are verbatim from that PUG-View record for CID 338 (RecordTitle 'Salicylic Acid'). The same record also carries a stricter industrial GHS classification (Signal 'Danger'; 'H318: Causes serious eye damage'), which is why the irritancy level is stated conservatively as 'low' based on the cosmetic-cream finding rather than the SDS classification. INCI name 'Salicylic Acid' matches the PubChem record title.

ingredients.publisher: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), National Library of Medicine (NLM), NIH — PubChem

known_effects.text_zh: 视黄醇在化妆品中的用途分类为“皮肤调理（Skin conditioning）”。
known_effects.locator: Use and Manufacturing > Uses > Use Classification

known_effects.text_zh: 局部外用维生素A可以逆转接受皮质类固醇患者出现的伤口愈合障碍，其机制可能是恢复了伤口正常的炎症反应。
known_effects.supporting_quote: Topical vitamin A can reverse the impairment of wound healing seen in patients receiving corticosteroids, perhaps by restoring the normal inflammatory reaction in the wound.
known_effects.locator: Pharmacology and Biochemistry > Mechanism of Action

irritancy.text_zh: ECHA C&L 通报汇总的 GHS 分类中，74.9% 的报告将视黄醇分类为 H317“可能导致皮肤过敏反应”，75.6% 分类为 H319“造成严重眼刺激”。该分类来自工业化学品的通报汇总，并非化妆品终产品的刺激性结论。
irritancy.supporting_quote: H302 (15.8%): Harmful if swallowed [Warning Acute toxicity, oral] | H317 (74.9%): May cause an allergic skin reaction [Warning Sensitization, Skin] | H319 (75.6%): Causes serious eye irritation [Warning Serious eye damage/eye irritation] | H360 (88.1%): May damage fertility or the unborn child [Danger Reproductive toxicity] | H413 (74.9%): May cause long lasting harmful effects to aquatic life [Hazardous to the aquatic environment, long-term hazard]
irritancy.locator: Safety and Hazards > Hazards Identification > GHS Classification > GHS Hazard Statements (ECHA C&L Inventory aggregation)

life_extension.text_zh: 维生素A对空气和光不稳定，应加以保护；维生素A制剂应储存在低于 40°C 的温度下，最好在 15–30°C 之间；口服维生素A制剂应存放于密封、避光的容器中，注射液应避光并避免冷冻。
life_extension.supporting_quote: Vitamin A is unstable in, and should be protected from, air and light. Vitamin A preparations should be stored at a temperature less than 40 °C, preferably between 15-30 °C. Oral vitamin A preparations should be stored in tight, light-resistant containers and the injection should be protected from light and freezing.
life_extension.locator: Safety and Hazards > Handling and Storage > Storage Conditions

ingredients.notes: CID 445154 is NOT retinol (it is resveratrol); the correct PubChem record for retinol is CID 445354, resolved via https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/retinol/cids/JSON. The compound page https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/445354 renders behind a reCAPTCHA challenge when fetched directly, so content was retrieved via https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug_view/data/compound/445354/JSON (HTTP 200, fetched 2026-10-15). All quotes are verbatim from that PUG-View record (RecordTitle 'Retinol'). The page did NOT contain any statement about photostability in a cosmetic formulation or any 'use sunscreen with retinol' advice, so no such claim was extracted; the life_extension entry is limited to the page's own light/air-instability and storage statement. The page's 'irritancy' evidence is an SDS/GHS sensitisation classification, not a cosmetic-use assessment.

products.directions_text_verbatim: Trage etwa 2 – 3 Fingerlängen auf Gesicht, Hals und Dekolleté auf. / 20 Minuten vor dem Aufenthalt in der Sonne, als letzten Schritt deiner Hautpflegeroutine / Auf Gesicht, Hals und Dekolleté und alle unbedeckten Stellen auftragen. / Sanft einmassieren, bis es von der Haut aufgenommen wird

key_actives.name: MEXORYL 400 (Methoxypropylamino Cyclohexenylidene Ethoxyethylcyanoacetate)
key_actives.snippet: Die bedeutende Innovation des UV-Schutzes nach 30 Jahren: MEXORYL 400 ist unser wirksamster UV-Filter, der auch vor schädlichen ultralangen UVA-Strahlen bis zu 400 nm schützt.

key_actives.name: NETLOCK TECHNOLOGY
key_actives.snippet: Die Netlock-Technologie schließt die UV-Filter in einer ultradünnen Schicht ein und bildet so einen unsichtbaren Schutz. Die Formel klebt, fettet und verläuft nicht, sodass ein homogener Schutzschild auf der Haut entsteht.

key_actives.name: XL-PROTECT
key_actives.snippet: Der Breitspektrum-Schutzfilter bildet eine kraftvolle Mischung aus UV-Filtern und Antioxidantien. Neben einem hochwirksamen Schutz gegen UVA- und UVB-Strahlen wird ein zusätzlicher Schutz vor Infrarotstrahlen und Luftverschmutzung geboten.
